summary:
Fix R is in the working tree, uncommitted (HEAD is still f7ac37d; docs.rar untouched). It adds six guards in five Physics modules:
1. Both ranks are keyed on the quantised distance from the grip's point (RANK_Q 1e-9). The verdict uses every Grip part (V4); the measure uses the kept Grip parts and is ranked after the verdicts.
2. MassProps' box pre-test uses −OVERLAP_TOL, with OVERLAP_TOL raised to 1e-7. The sign was measured: −OVERLAP_TOL is closer to the exact or fine reference on 9,947 designs vs 271.
3. An overlap box ≤1e-9 thick gets no cell; otherwise ceil(extent/h − 1e-9).
4. Asymmetry's mirror candidates look reach + 1e-9 out.
5. G sums each x rounded to 1e-9.
